governance.attested_by: session nyiso-fuelvintage-1 shard H2 (2026-09-09). THE CORRECTED 2022 VALIDATION TOUCHPOINT. The keeper 2026-09-07-nyiso-213-summer-seam's FROZEN RECIPE replayed on the held-out year 2022 (scripts/replay_keeper.py results/calibration/nyiso213_summer_seam --years 2022 --holdout-authorized), on the CORRECTED EIA-860 within-window retiree artifact. It SUPERSEDES 2026-09-07-nyiso-213-tp2022 and 2026-09-06-nyiso-209-2022-touchpoint, both of which were scored on a fleet whose within-window retiree table started at 2023 and therefore OMITTED every NYISO unit that retired during 2022 itself. THE ARM IS A DATA CORRECTION, NOT A CONFIG CHANGE (rule 14 [R-ACCURATE]): data/raw/eia-860/eia860_generator_retired_within_window.parquet was widened to 1,094 rows / min planned_retirement_year 2019, restoring 11 NYIS generator rows totalling 526.6 MW of net summer capacity that were operating for part of 2022 -- Dunkirk Generating Plant 445.0 MW (units 1/3/ST4, conventional steam coal, retired month 4), Nassau Energy Corp 50.0 MW (GT1+ST1 gas CC, month 7), Hudson Avenue 27.6 MW (GT3+GT5 petroleum liquids, month 11) and 4.0 MW of landfill gas (Waste Management Madison County, Al Turi). The units enter through the SAME COD-ramp machinery every other within-window exit uses, month-masked at their own filed retirement month; the 2022 solve masks 548 unit-months offline and carries 33 units fully not-yet-built/retired. The correction lands because it is CORRECT, not because it improves anything: rule 14 forbids preferring the estimate, and rule 1 [R-STRUCT] forbids judging it by the residual. G-DELTA = ZERO RECIPE CHANGES. run_config.scenario_config differs from the keeper's in 12 keys, ALL of which are NEW ScenarioConfig dataclass fields added to HEAD since the keeper solved, reported not counted: ercot_ep_gas_basis_corroborated=False, ercot_zonal_spread_ep_referenced=False, gas_electric_power_monthly_level=False, hydro_budget_period_by_instrument=False, netload_drag_layup_window_mask=False, netload_drag_merit_allocation=False, netload_drag_min_run_persistence=False, pjm_seam_neighbour_hourly_ladder=False, pjm_thermal_accreditation_vintage=False, spp_gas_commitment_bridge=False, vre_curtailment_oversupply_allocation=False (all default-off, none in this recipe), and f923_gas_price_plausibility_screen=True, which IS on the NYISO backcast path and is therefore audited rather than assumed: it repriced 0 plants in 2022 and 0 plants in each of 2023/2024/2025 (60/60/60/59 plant-months all in band, 0 low, 0 negative, 0 high), i.e. MEASURED INERT, not argued inert. ZERO free parameters added, ZERO DOF entries added (13 / n_residual 6 carried verbatim from the keeper). authorized_price_tuning: NONE -- the offer-curve bands are the keeper's, byte-identical. G-CONTROL = the keeper's COMMITTED bundle (rule 29(b) form 4; NO control solve was spent on the touchpoint). THE IN-SAMPLE INERTNESS IS MEASURED, NOT ASSUMED, AND IT IS THE CENTRAL FINDING: this session additionally re-solved the FULL 2023-2025 training span on the corrected artifact at this HEAD (results/nyiso_fuelvintage_span, 6/6 passes optimal) and differenced it class-by-class against the keeper's committed hourly sidecars. Max |class annual TWh delta| = 0.0030 (2023), 0.0039 (2024), 0.0139 (2025) -- all on the order of LP degeneracy between alternate optima, against total model energy of 148.31 / 152.18 / 153.21 TWh matching the keeper to four decimals. THIS IS EXPECTED BY CONSTRUCTION: a unit that retired in 2019-2022 is already absent from a 2023+ fleet, so widening the window backwards can only reach years <= 2022. CONSEQUENCE: THERE IS NO NEW KEEPER CANDIDATE. The training-tier verdict is unchanged, so NYISO's determination remains the keeper's own CALIBRATED (grade 7/8, zero fails, C3c the lone ledgered caveat), and NOTHING IS PROMOTED by this session. RULE 30(c): A HELD-OUT YEAR NEVER DOWNGRADES THE ISO -- this rung can neither certify nor decertify, and it is folded to the keeper under rule 30 [R-TOUCHPOINT-FOLD](a) rather than published as a separate card. RULE 22: NOTHING IS IDENTIFIED AGAINST 2022. No parameter, band or construction was chosen with any 2022 number in view; the recipe was frozen and promoted on 2023-2025 before this year was solved, and the artifact widening is a source-data repair with zero degrees of freedom, not a fit. AUTHORIZATION: NYISO holds the `complete` marker, the STANDING authorization for iterating the 2020-2022 validation touchpoints; holdout_policy.registration_refusals([2022],'NYISO',...) returns [] at both solve launch and registration (rule 22's R-AZ re-check). `final` remains ABSENT and the locked-test freeze (scope.tiers=['locked_test']) is untouched: 2019 and H1-2026 are NOT granted and NOT spent. 2020 and 2021 remain UNSPENT. REPORTED AT FULL MAGNITUDE, NOT ABSORBED: the corrected fleet makes the 2022 rung's headline miss WORSE. The superseded nyiso-213-tp2022 read C1 CC_REGULAR +5.01 TWh; on the corrected fleet the class rises further. That is the expected direction -- restoring 526.6 MW of retiring coal/oil/CC capacity to a market whose model already over-produces CC_REGULAR -- and under rules 1 and 14 it is a ROOT-CAUSE SIGNAL, never a reason to revert the input. The object handed forward is unchanged and now better evidenced: NYISO's CC_REGULAR AGGREGATE OVER-PRODUCTION.
